act_type.rationale: The speaker makes descriptive claims about a system's design philosophy and mechanics — what it does, how it works, why it is built this way. No directive, commissive, or declarative force is present; the entire text is truth-claiming about an artifact.

cooperative.implicature: The acknowledged vagueness of the social-science framing is intentional and functional — openness is the feature that lets structure emerge from data rather than be imposed on it.

transmission.rationale: Dense, compressed, written to preserve design intent for future reference rather than to elicit an immediate response. The note-like compression and explicit rule statements read as specification-for-the-record, not live dialogue.

resonance.surface: Calm, coherent technical description presenting the system as internally consistent and purposeful.
resonance.underlying: Epistemological friction between subjective felt-meaning (left: nouns from felt experience) and objective pattern detection (right: structure and process) — the system's core tension mirrors the conflict domain it models, but the text presents this as resolved.

authority.source: Self-derived emergent logic — co-occurrence thresholds, clump formation rules, and keyword polarity are internally generated, explicitly rejecting external taxonomies and dependencies.
authority.rationale: Zero external dependencies and pure local co-occurrence signal that authority resides in the system's own emergent structure, not in formal institutions or peer consensus. The knowledge is real and operative but unrecognized by any official record.

utility.rationale: The text enables action by specifying system mechanics: API behavior, co-occurrence thresholds, clump formation rules, keyword polarity. Secondarily it makes meaning by framing design philosophy — why vagueness is acceptable and what the system is ultimately for.

social_field.rationale: Moderate-high self-imposed grid (explicit co-occurrence thresholds, formal API, clump formation rules with numeric triggers) with very low group anchoring (zero external dependencies, no appeal to communal standards or peer authority). The rules are internal and self-referential, not socially negotiated.

conflict.rationale: A conflict-modeling system operated from an isolate social position under occult authority, with its own epistemological tension presented as resolved, is structurally entangled with the conflict terrain it claims to predict — creating conditions where the intervention mechanism becomes subject to the same dynamics it monitors, without an accountability layer to detect the capture.

raw_text: Honestly the open-ended social science is nebulous hence vague - this is the purpose, rest is a vehicle for discovering data, and a secure foundation mostly there to assure integrity. The prediction API takes conflict text and predicts beneficial resolution paths. High tension equals high intervention opportunity. Emotional truth on the left versus pattern detection on the right produces a tension score. Beneficial signals emerge where resolution focus and adaptive compromise co-occur more than three times. Conflict asymmetry and emotional deescalation co-occurring signals beneficial outcomes. Clump formation rules emerge from co-occurrence above two inferences. Gatekeeping behavior plus access block forms gatekeeping clump. Left semantic keywords are nouns only from felt meaning. Right digital keywords are structure and process. Zero external dependencies. Pure local co-occurrence to emergent structure to beneficial prediction.
